hook_text: Five lines, three views, four forces, three rust cures, five stages, two allowances. The whole term fits on one page, from memory.
clip_script: Column one, drawing: dark, feint, dashed, wavy, chain. Standard scale in the title block, real sizes once. Top view under the front, side view on the opposite side, feint lines joining them. Column two, forces: still or moving, spread or bunched. Pull, push, bend, twist. Steel on the stretched side. Tubes and triangles beat twist. Rust is iron, air, water; zinc beats paint. Column three, process: investigate, brief without the answer, specs with numbers, two ideas, scorecard, drawing, flow chart, model, budget rounded up plus ten and ten, tender in IDMEC order. Write it from memory. Check it. Fix in another colour. That page is your revision for the year.
visual_style: Whiteboard page dividing into three columns that fill with short rules; a red pen correcting two gaps; the models on a windowsill in the background sketch.
pacing: Three columns at speed, then the memory-and-correct method.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and write your own one page before you look at your notes.
